final: WITH counts AS (SELECT a.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM counts), compared AS (SELECT tradekind, record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS average_type_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, AVG(record_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_type_share) AS average_margin FROM compared WHERE share > average_type_share GROUP BY tradekind
